    "textPayload": "    message: \"<expr type=\\\"expression\\\" label=\\\"apologetic\\\"/> My apologies, <expr type=\\\"break\\\" label=\\\"300ms\\\"/> I didn't mean to repeat myself. <expr type=\\\"expression\\\" label=\\\"content\\\"/> Thank you for bearing with me! <expr type=\\\"break\\\" label=\\\"500ms\\\"/> \\n\\n<expr type=\\\"expression\\\" label=\\\"confident\\\"/> Thank you for your patience, Patten — your initial results are in, and your affordability summary is ready for you. <expr type=\\\"expression\\\" label=\\\"calm\\\"/> It brings together the income and savings targets you shared with me and the details from your credit review, and shows how your numbers compare with typical program guideline ranges. <expr type=\\\"break\\\" label=\\\"500ms\\\"/> One important note before we look at it together: <expr type=\\\"expression\\\" label=\\\"calm\\\"/> this is an educational summary to help you explore — it is not a loan decision, and you can submit for the formal eligibility review at any time, no matter what these ranges show. <expr type=\\\"break\\\" label=\\\"500ms\\\"/> \\n\\n<expr type=\\\"expression\\\" label=\\\"happy\\\"/> Your summary opens on the Conventional view — you can switch tabs anytime to see how your scenario looks under different program types. <expr type=\\\"break\\\" label=\\\"300ms\\\"/> Would you like to walk through it together?\"",
